library.rt_160:r_824382c70a5ab386.text:
A giant-type robot that appeared in Episode 2, 'Activate! Mazinger!'
It has the appearance of an ancient gladiator, and some units had a Mechanical Beast hidden inside.
Many units of the same type existed, and they were also used for excavation work on Mycenae's legacy.

library.rt_160:r_51dbe6b306f475c0.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae, a god among gods.
Long ago, he rebelled against the gods of Mycenae to protect humanity.
In battle, his body's armor shines gold. The weapon he wields changes freely, normally a sword but sometimes transforming into a spear. The letter 'Z' is also engraved on his sword and forehead.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient Mycenae, the world of Kedora's memories.

library.rt_160:r_46a8d03a9b8a9600.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae, a god among gods.
Long ago, he rebelled against the gods of Mycenae to protect humanity.
In battle, his body's armor shines gold. The weapon he wields changes freely, normally a sword but sometimes transforming into a spear. The letter 'Z' is also engraved on his sword and forehead.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient Mycenae, the world of Kedora's memories.
Caught off guard by a scheme, he had his right arm cut off by Hades, but by fighting alongside $$マジンガーＺ$$, he drove Hades back. The severed right arm turned into Japanium ore, and was left underground on Bardos Island as the source of Super Alloy Z and photon energy.

library.rt_160:r_6a33f61c5bf4e917.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae.
Known by the names 'King of Hell' and 'King of the Underworld,' he rules over the land of the dead.
He wields the power of flame, fighting with a pair of greatswords wrapped in crimson hellfire.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient Mycenae, the world of Kedora's memories.

library.rt_160:r_a67f7f13015d78db.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae.
Known by the names 'King of Hell' and 'King of the Underworld,' he rules over the land of the dead.
He wields the power of flame, fighting with a pair of greatswords wrapped in crimson hellfire.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient Mycenae, the world of Kedora's memories.
He conspired with Grand Duke Gorgon to eliminate Zeus, his fellow member of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae, but was defeated by the combined efforts of $$マジンガーＺ$$ and Zeus. However, as he lay dying, he declared he would return as the Dark Emperor, and vanished into the flames.

library.rt_160:r_64d8b2c65810684a.text:
A Mechanical God of Mycenae.
He is called 'the $$ブレイヴ$$ One' for his valor.
After the passage of many years, his body was split into the Mechanical Beasts $$ガラダＫ７$$ and Dublas M2.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient Mycenae, the world of Kedora's memories.
Unlike ordinary Mechanical Beasts, he has a will of his own and is even able to speak.

library.rt_160:r_c70ba26c54ff07e3.text:
An anti-$$ヘテロダイン$$ combat weapon belonging to the Public Relations Section 2 of the Planning and Development Department, owned by $$２１世紀警備保障$$. Its official designation is 'Type-B Upright Special Vehicle.'
Humanity, first exposed to the threat of the Heterodynes in the year 2018, developed it in preparation for their reappearance, but for the following 12 years no $$ヘテロダイン$$ appeared, and it ended up merely consuming upkeep costs. Later, when the $$ＵＮ$$ Security Forces decided on privatization, $$２１世紀警備保障$$ was born as a security company with the military as its major shareholder. $$ダイ・ガード$$ came under its ownership, a state that continues to this day.
Even after becoming a semi-public, semi-private organization, the problem of operating costs could not be ignored, and it was treated mainly as a promotional mascot. However, when the second $$ヘテロダイン$$ in 12 years appeared in Sagami Bay, the coincidence of it being on display on-site and having its pilots on hand became the catalyst for it to return to its original role, and it continued to be deployed from then on.
Initially, due to operational and maintenance issues, it stood by in a disassembled state, requiring a crane to be set up on-site to assemble it every time it sortied. However, it was improved into a three-block configuration -- Unit 1 comprising the head and both arms, Unit 2 the upper body, and Unit 3 the lower body -- and by fitting each block with an optional self-propelled system, its operability was successfully improved. Furthermore, the armor, which had been reduced to little more than paper for weight reduction during its time as a mascot, was restored to its original titanium-based multilayer armor.
Its armaments include the cutting 'Drill Arm,' the capture-type 'Net Arm,' and the 'Knot Buster,' which pinpoint-destroys an $$オリジナル$$'s Fractal Knot. Although categorized as a weapon, being the property of a private company, it is equipped only with equipment specialized purely for use against Heterodynes.
Later, its combat strength was enhanced by equipping improved versions of its weapons, the 'Knot Punisher' and 'Double Driller' (both named by Akagi), and an OS that changed hardware priority was developed to improve its mobility. Furthermore, to make combination easier, various power-ups were carried out over time: Unit 1 was fitted with flight capability and became the 'Guard Fighter,' Unit 2 gained hovering capability and became the 'Guard Striker,' and Unit 3 had its parts modified into the 'Guard Vehicle' (these names, too, were coined by Akagi). Even so, its basic concept as an anti-$$ヘテロダイン$$ combat weapon never changed.

library.rt_160:r_2852ee8f28de3b14.text:
A pestle-shaped $$ヘテロダイン$$ that appeared in Episode 13, 'One Who Is Forgiven, One Who Is Not.' Its scientific name is '$$ヘテロダイン・コンパーゲス$$.' The listed weight is only an estimated figure.
80% of its outer shell is composed of carbon (the rest are fourth-period transition elements), and it uses high-speed vibrating tentacles for both attack and defense.
It appeared at Aokigahara and toyed with the Security Forces, who staked their pride on defeating the $$ヘテロダイン$$ by themselves. In the end it faced off against $$ダイ・ガード$$ and vanished after its Fractal Knot was pierced by the Knot Punisher.

library.rt_160:r_2307bf69f48823a5.text:
The black Megadeus piloted by $$ロジャー・スミス$$.
When $$ロジャー$$ shouts '$$ビッグオー$$, Showtime!' into the wristwatch on his left arm, it emerges from underground to face the enemy alongside him.
When $$ロジャー$$ boards, the front monitor displays the inscription 'CAST IN THE NAME OF GOD, YE NOT GUILTY' (I cast this in the name of God; you are not guilty).
It is normally stored beneath $$ロジャー$$'s mansion. But once summoned by $$ロジャー$$, it races to its destination through disused underground transit tunnels aboard its dedicated transporter, the 'Prairie Dog.'
It conceals built-in weapons such as the eye-mounted beam 'Arc Line' and the 'Cannon Party' and 'Missile Party' fired from its chest and abdomen, but its ultimate finishing move is 'Sudden Impact,' a one-hit-kill strike delivered by driving its arm's Strike Pile into the enemy.
Other weapons exist as well, and these were revealed over the course of its battles.
Like the other Bigs, it occasionally takes action of its own accord as though it has a will, and remains shrouded in mystery -- even its pilot, $$ロジャー$$, does not know when, where, or by whom it was built, or for what purpose.

library.rt_160:r_cdb11f5db699c26f.text:
A Megadeus that appeared in Act 09, '$$ベック$$ Comes Back.' Also known as 'Super $$ベック$$.'
$$Ｔボーン$$ and $$ダヴ$$ used it to break $$ベック$$ out of prison.
It is built using parts from a Heavy Metal unit stolen from Wise Company.
Its weapons include missiles stored in both sides of its chest and a beam fired from its fingertips. The beam has enough power to sever Moby Dick's anchor chain, but when it struck $$ビッグオー$$'s head crystal, it was deflected.
It is characterized by its speedy getaways and its upper body's ability to rotate 180 degrees, a function it was also seen using to launch a surprise attack on $$ビッグオー$$.

library.rt_160:r_9dd3bd8b9bd5cbb7.text:
A Megadeus discovered by $$シュバルツ$$.
If $$ビッグオー$$ is the Big of the land, then $$ビッグデュオ$$ can be called the Big of the sky.
It deploys main wings from both arms, transforms its four fingers into propellers, and flies using the afterburners of its powerful engines.
Its armaments include the eye-mounted beam 'Arc Line,' the chest-mounted 'Gatling Missile,' and the 'Megaton Missile' stored in both lower legs. The four finger propellers can also be spun to shred an opponent.
Its piloting method and cockpit layout are the same as $$ビッグオー$$'s, but it can also act of its own accord even without a pilot aboard, making it a Megadeus full of mysteries.
On its first appearance, it was known as 'Megadeus Mummy,' appearing wrapped head to toe in bandages, giving off an eerie atmosphere.

library.rt_160:r_6583e455f53c8d1d.text:
A Megadeus discovered by $$シュバルツ$$.
If $$ビッグオー$$ is the Big of the land, then $$ビッグデュオ$$ can be called the Big of the sky.
It deploys main wings from both arms, transforms its four fingers into propellers, and flies using the afterburners of its powerful engines.

When it faced off against $$ビッグオー$$ at the Central Dome, it tormented $$ビッグオー$$ with bombardment from the sky. However, $$ロジャー$$'s quick-witted tactics turned the tables, and it was left badly damaged.
Afterward it reacted to $$ドロシー#240$$'s presence and, as if pursuing her, advanced on foot with no one aboard, before eventually coming to a stop.

library.rt_160:r_dd81ad0c69bf9931.text:
A white Megadeus piloted by Alex Rosewater.
Where $$ビッグオー$$ is the Big of the land and $$ビッグデュオ$$ the Big of the sky, $$ビッグファウ$$ can be called the Big of the sea, built to excel at underwater activity.
Because it was found in a foreign land in pieces, Alex requested that the Union recover it, having its parts loaded onto three Megadei and transported to Paradigm City.
It was assembled in Paradigm Corporation's underground factory using every technique the science division could muster, but because its core memory was missing, it ran amok and fell into malfunction on its first sortie. Later, however, by installing a memory circuit extracted from $$ドロシー#240$$ to substitute for the core memory's function, Alex became able to fully control $$ビッグファウ$$.
Its weapons are the tentacle-like beam cannon extending from its back, the cannon that juts out from its shoulder, and the 'Corkscrew Punch,' an attack made by spinning the rotors on its arms.
It can also move freely underwater by using its rotors as screws.

library.rt_160:r_460ea882ef563b72.text:
A Megadeus shrouded entirely in mystery.
Its coloring appears to be $$ビッグオー$$'s inverted.
It has an ominous countenance, and is characterized by what looks like the scar of torn-off wings on its back, matching the mark on Angel's body.
It bears the role of resetting the world, possessing the special ability to erase the entire existence of anything it passes through.
It awakened when Angel, the creator of Paradigm City, realized her own existence as a memory and tried to return to her original place.

library.rt_160:r_b08ba398b8070bc4.text:
A cutting-edge third-generation AS.
It is operated by $$ミスリル$$, and this unit is piloted by Sergeant Major $$メリッサ・マオ$$.
This model is said to still be under development by the US military, and has not yet been deployed to any organization or nation other than $$ミスリル$$. As $$ミスリル$$'s main weapon, machines of the E series are operated by $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel.
Compared to existing machines it boasts extremely high performance, and its high mobility and stealth in particular overwhelm other AS. Its $$ＥＣＳ$$ not only neutralizes electronic weapons such as sensors and radar, but also renders it invisible to the naked eye.
The greatest feature of $$マオ$$'s unit is the composite blade antenna mounted on its head unit, which enhances its sensor capabilities. This grants it the electronic warfare capability required of a frontline command unit. The high-altitude data-link device 'ITCC-5 (Integrated Tactical Communication Control System)' enables it to integrate, manage, and analyze the vast amounts of data on the battlefield.
Its main armaments are a 40mm assault rifle and a monomolecular cutter.

library.rt_160:r_eaf1e6b0e84d210f.text:
A cutting-edge third-generation AS.
It is operated by $$ミスリル$$, and this unit is piloted by Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$.
This model is said to still be under development by the US military, and has not yet been deployed to any organization or nation other than $$ミスリル$$. As $$ミスリル$$'s main weapon, machines of the E series are operated by $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel.
Compared to existing machines it boasts extremely high performance, and its high mobility and stealth in particular overwhelm other AS. Its $$ＥＣＳ$$ not only neutralizes electronic weapons such as sensors and radar, but also renders it invisible to the naked eye. This performance was also put to use when it operated through the city streets on a mission to guard $$かなめ$$.
$$クルツ$$'s unit is most distinguished by its 57mm smoothbore gun. It is normally folded and mounted on the back, but is deployed for use, and the bipod beneath the barrel is used to snipe from a prone firing position.

library.rt_160:r_e8e5471f4523a4c1.text:
A cutting-edge third-generation AS.
It is operated by $$ミスリル$$, and this unit is piloted by Sergeant $$相良宗介$$.
This model is said to still be under development by the US military, and has not yet been deployed to any organization or nation other than $$ミスリル$$. As $$ミスリル$$'s main weapon, machines of the E series are operated by $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel.
Compared to existing machines it boasts extremely high performance, and its high mobility and stealth in particular overwhelm other AS. Its $$ＥＣＳ$$ not only neutralizes electronic weapons such as sensors and radar, but also renders it invisible to the naked eye.
It was used in $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operations, including rescuing a girl being pursued by the military in Siberia.

This model is said to still be under development by the US military, and has not yet been deployed to any organization or nation other than $$ミスリル$$. As $$ミスリル$$'s main weapon, machines of the E series are operated by $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel.

After the hijacking incident in the Hanka Autonomous Region, $$宗介$$ became the dedicated operator of the Arbalest, and so never piloted this unit again.

library.rt_160:r_2eae668e217daf3c.text:
An AS owned by the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$.
Sergeant $$相良宗介$$ is its designated operator (pilot).
A cutting-edge third-generation AS developed based on the M9. Its greatest feature is the black technology it carries, the 'Lambda Driver.' The Lambda Driver is a system that converts the pilot's aggressive impulses into physical force, allowing it to display power and mobility impossible for an ordinary AS. Of all the AS $$ミスリル$$ possesses, this is the only unit fitted with this system. However, because its activation is somewhat unreliable, $$宗介$$ initially considered it lacking in reliability as a weapon and felt an aversion toward it.
Its equipment follows $$ミスリル$$'s common specifications, allowing it to use the M9's gear as-is. Its main armaments are the Boxer shotgun and monomolecular cutter that $$宗介$$ favors, with two fixed chain guns and wire guns mounted on both arms. Its power source is a palladium reactor, with a maximum operational endurance of 100 hours.
Its AI's call sign is $$アル$$. It optimized itself to $$宗介$$ as its pilot the first time he boarded the Arbalest. Afterward this setting cannot be changed, and no one but him can activate the Lambda Driver -- making it a machine of many mysteries.
It was initially deployed to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ as an expensive experimental unit, but $$宗介$$ came to pilot it during the hijacking incident in the Hanka Autonomous Region.
From then on, through many twists and turns, it fought through numerous fierce battles alongside him.

library.rt_160:r_23ef926cdb2f9838.text:
An assault landing submarine, and the flagship of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet.
Its captain is Colonel $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$. Its design is also her own work, and she holds a deep attachment to it.
It is the largest submarine in history, and also the largest weapon $$ミスリル$$ possesses. Its crew numbers roughly 250.
Its main engine is a palladium reactor, and its propulsion system is SCD (Superconducting Drive). Its hull surface is fitted with EMFC (Electro-Magnetic Fluid Control) equipment, giving it excellent navigational performance and quietness. Its operational systems are highly computerized, with the ship's equipment and instruments controlled by the central computer, the mother AI '$$ダーナ$$.'
The ship carries 8 AS units, and uses a flight deck among other facilities for sorties.
Enemy organizations and elements of the US Navy call this elusive, ever-appearing-and-vanishing ship the ghost submarine 'Toy Box.'

library.rt_160:r_0ec34f5ea4e8188f.text:
The main AS of the Western nations.
It was the first AS to be classified as second-generation, possessing performance and versatility that overwhelm conventional weapons. The completion of this machine proved the usefulness of AS on the battlefield, leading advanced nations to proceed with forming AS units. The Type 96, deployed by Japan's Self-Defense Forces, was also developed based on this machine.
Its power source is a gas turbine engine. Its armor is composite armor consisting mainly of aluminum along with tungsten and ceramic materials.

library.rt_160:r_fcc137c1ae5a93d8.text:
A second-generation AS.
It has no head unit, and is characterized by a unique design combining sloped armor. For a second-generation machine, it excels in mobility and maneuverability.
Besides its fixed 20mm autocannon, it uses handheld weapons such as a 35mm rifle, a monomolecular cutter, and anti-tank missiles.
It has been exported and deployed worldwide, including to the Middle East and South America.

library.rt_160:r_0829813a3e973203.text:
A second-generation AS of Eastern manufacture.
This machine has been widely supplied to Eastern bloc nations, and its greatest strength is its highly reliable, rugged construction. Its simple appearance carries on the characteristics of Eastern-made weapons, excelling in durability and ballistic deflection. It falls behind Western AS in areas such as electronic equipment, but its simple structure and equipment make it easy to manufacture and maintain. Thanks to its ease of handling and low cost, it is operated by a wide range of organizations, from Eastern bloc nations to guerrilla forces around the world.
Its main armaments are a 37mm rifle, an ATD (anti-tank dagger), and a monomolecular cutter.

library.rt_160:r_f27de58d9daa7787.text:
A third-generation AS currently under trial by the Eastern bloc.
It carries the same palladium reactor as the M9, the West's next-generation main AS, and its basic performance rivals the M9's, though it lags behind in electronic weaponry.
Its main armaments are an assault rifle and a monomolecular cutter, with a wire gun as a fixed weapon.
Organizations hostile to $$ミスリル$$ also operate it, and custom units exist as well.

library.rt_160:r_2526a91272f79d14.text:
A third-generation AS currently under trial by the Eastern bloc.
It carries the same palladium reactor as the M9, the West's next-generation main AS, and its basic performance rivals the M9's, though it lags behind in electronic weaponry.
Its main armaments are an assault rifle and a monomolecular cutter, with a wire gun as a fixed weapon.
The secret organization Amalgam also operates it, and custom units exist as well.

library.rt_160:r_c07282f597f8124d.text:
A third-generation AS currently under trial by the Eastern bloc.
This unit was piloted by $$ザイード$$.
It is characterized by the gatling cannon on its right arm and its red personal color. Its various parts have also been tuned up, giving it maneuverability rivaling that of the Codarl piloted by $$ガウルン$$.
In the battle in Helmajistan, it used its knowledge of the terrain to destroy $$ミスリル$$'s M9s one after another.

library.rt_160:r_82f5c7a46e51adca.text:
A third-generation AS currently under trial by the Eastern bloc.
This unit was piloted by $$ザイード$$.
It is characterized by the gatling cannon on its right arm and its red personal color. Its various parts have also been tuned up, giving it maneuverability rivaling that of the Codarl piloted by $$ガウルン$$.
In the battle in Helmajistan, it used its knowledge of the terrain to destroy $$ミスリル$$'s M9s one after another. However, it was destroyed by a desperate strike from $$宗介$$'s Arbalest.

library.rt_160:r_4cb1db7f6468fd3e.text:
An AS operated by a mysterious organization, piloted by $$ガウルン$$.
It is believed to have been developed based on the Eastern third-generation AS, the Zy-98. Its greatest feature is that it is fitted with a Lambda Driver, which allows it to display combat power surpassing the M9, the West's equivalent third-generation AS.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
Its pilot, $$ガウルン$$, masterfully wields the Lambda Driver to fight $$ミスリル$$'s AS units.

library.rt_160:r_ff223297ea4476f1.text:
An AS operated by the secret organization Amalgam, piloted by $$ガウルン$$.
It is believed to have been developed based on the Eastern third-generation AS, the Zy-98. Its greatest feature is that it is fitted with a Lambda Driver, which allows it to display combat power surpassing the M9, the West's equivalent third-generation AS.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
Its pilot, $$ガウルン$$, masterfully wields the Lambda Driver to fight $$ミスリル$$'s AS units. In the hijacking incident in the Hanka Autonomous Region, it destroyed $$クルツ$$'s M9. However, it was destroyed by $$宗介$$'s Arbalest after he activated his own Lambda Driver.

library.rt_160:r_0bc5e4299167dc87.text:
An AS operated by a mysterious organization, piloted by $$ガウルン$$.
It is characterized by its red coloring, and is called 'Venom' by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine of the same lineage as the Codarl, but has had improvements added to each part, giving it a different design starting with its head. It is also newly equipped with a gatling cannon.
In battles such as the one at Beryldawe Island, it demonstrated this performance and drove $$ミスリル$$ into a corner.

library.rt_160:r_a89b3081bc11f520.text:
An AS operated by the secret organization Amalgam, piloted by $$ガウルン$$.
It is characterized by its red coloring, and is called 'Venom' by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine of the same lineage as the Codarl, but has had improvements added to each part, giving it a different design starting with its head. It is also newly equipped with a gatling cannon.
In battles such as the one at Beryldawe Island, it demonstrated this performance and drove $$ミスリル$$ into a corner. However, during its battle with the Arbalest inside the Danaan, it activated its self-destruct device intending to destroy the ship along with itself, but was ejected by the catapult and exploded violently over the ocean.

library.rt_160:r_cbf706cc3d2baa25.text:
A super-giant AS possessed by the terrorist group 'A21.'
Its pilot is $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$.
It is so massive that it cannot even support its own weight without activating its Lambda Driver.
Its main armaments are a giant sword and a 30mm autocannon mounted on its head.
Hidden aboard a cargo ship, it was activated by $$タクマ$$, who crushed the JGSDF's Narashino Assault Company deployed to suppress it, and attempted to destroy the entire Tokyo Bay area.

library.rt_160:r_a5b173b748ad5663.text:
A super-giant AS possessed by the terrorist group 'A21.'
Its pilot is $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$.
It is so massive that it cannot even support its own weight without activating its Lambda Driver.
Its main armaments are a giant sword and a 30mm autocannon mounted on its head.
Hidden aboard a cargo ship, it was activated by $$タクマ$$, who crushed the JGSDF's Narashino Assault Company deployed to suppress it, and attempted to destroy the entire Tokyo Bay area. In the end, it faced off against $$宗介$$'s Arbalest, which destroyed the cooling unit at the base of its leg and shut down the function of its Lambda Driver. As a result, unable to support its own weight, it collapsed.

library.rt_160:r_c125736b292b842e.text:
The mascot character of the amusement park '$$ふもふもランド$$'... modified by $$宗介$$.
It is generally called a costume, but in reality it can be called a small-scale AS, equipped internally with all sorts of machinery.
Its distinguishing external feature is the cross-shaped scar on its left cheek, matching $$宗介$$'s own.
It is also fitted with the voice-changer function originally built into the costume, and for some reason, all of its functions stop working if this is turned off. Because of this, the function must always be kept on, and as a result, no matter what it says, it comes out externally as words resembling 'fumoffu!' $$かなめ$$, however, can understand its meaning and interpret for it.
With agility that its round body would never suggest, along with its firearms, it takes down villains and the like.

library.rt_160:r_9e17da3437ca0496.text:
A D-series prototype of the M9 possessed by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine that was transferred to the West Pacific fleet from the Mediterranean fleet together with $$クルーゾー$$.
It is a Western-developed third-generation AS, and while its basic performance does not differ from the mass-produced E-series machines, its coloring has been changed to black, and armor has been added to its upper body.
$$クルーゾー$$'s unit is also equipped with the high-altitude data-link device 'ITCC-5 (Integrated Tactical Communication Control System),' giving it functions as a command unit as well.
Its main armaments are a 40mm assault rifle and the Crimson Edge monomolecular cutter.
It rescued $$宗介$$ and the others while they were being pursued on Sicily, and afterward, in a mock battle shortly after his transfer, $$クルーゾー$$'s combat sense and piloting skill overwhelmed $$宗介$$'s Arbalest.

library.rt_160:r_ce82906da2b150ff.text:
A third-generation AS currently under trial by the Eastern bloc.
This version was piloted by $$玉芳$$.
It carries the same palladium reactor as the M9, the West's main AS. Its basic performance is said to rival the M9's, though its electronic weaponry lags behind.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and a monomolecular cutter, with a wire gun as a fixed weapon. It is also equipped with a composite-type monomolecular cutter that can switch to gun mode for shooting, which $$玉芳$$ dual-wielded to drive $$クルツ$$'s M9 into a corner.
During the meeting between $$ゲイツ$$ and Colonel Mares, it lay hidden in invisible mode using next-generation $$ＥＣＳ$$, and went on to destroy the Mistral II and others.

library.rt_160:r_cd8c4808037f4a9f.text:
An AS operated by a mysterious organization, piloted by $$ゲイツ$$.
It is characterized by its red coloring, and is called 'Venom' by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine of the same lineage as the Codarl, but has had improvements added to each part, giving it a different design starting with its head.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
$$ゲイツ$$ effortlessly masters the installed Lambda Driver to fight against $$ミスリル$$.

library.rt_160:r_9dc3193292c443fc.text:
An AS operated by the secret organization Amalgam, piloted by $$ゲイツ$$.
It is characterized by its red coloring, and is called 'Venom' by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine of the same lineage as the Codarl, but has had improvements added to each part, giving it a different design starting with its head.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
$$ゲイツ$$ effortlessly masters the installed Lambda Driver to fight against $$ミスリル$$. In the incident at the Yangtze River Crossing Tunnel, he engaged $$宗介$$'s Arbalest in combat. He overwhelmed the Arbalest, whose Lambda Driver activation was unstable, but his own machine overheated and he withdrew. Then in Hong Kong, he led a squadron of mass-production units against $$ミスリル$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team), driving them into a corner. However, when the Arbalest arrived to their rescue, the tide of battle turned completely. Struck by a blow from $$宗介$$'s Lambda Driver, wielded now that he had cast aside his doubts, it exploded and was destroyed.

library.rt_160:r_459dcc0ad29cef6c.text:
An AS operated by a mysterious organization.
$$玉芳$$ stole it when she broke away from the organization.
Under $$ミスリル$$'s classification code, it is designated a 'Venom' type machine.
This unit, piloted by $$玉芳$$, is believed to be a machine of the same lineage as an improved $$プラン１０５６　コダール$$, though the details are unknown.
Its main armament is a composite-type monomolecular cutter.
On $$ガウルン$$'s orders, she destroys parts of Hong Kong to lure $$ミスリル$$ out.

library.rt_160:r_ee120534ad7f954c.text:
An AS operated by the secret organization Amalgam.
$$玉芳$$ stole it when she broke away from the organization.
Under $$ミスリル$$'s classification code, it is designated a 'Venom' type machine.
This unit, piloted by $$玉芳$$, is believed to be a machine of the same lineage as an improved $$プラン１０５６　コダール$$, though the details are unknown.
Its main armament is a composite-type monomolecular cutter.
On $$ガウルン$$'s orders, she destroys parts of Hong Kong to lure $$ミスリル$$ out, but in the end is purged by $$ゲイツ$$' Codarl-i and explodes, destroyed.

library.rt_160:r_64e3ef463bfd6473.text:
An AS operated by a mysterious organization.
Under $$ミスリル$$'s classification code, it is designated a 'Venom' type machine.
It is said to have been developed based on the Eastern third-generation AS, the Zy-98, but its greatest feature is that this unit is fitted with a Lambda Driver, which allows it to display combat power surpassing the M9, the West's equivalent third-generation AS.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
In Hong Kong it appeared alongside $$ゲイツ$$' unit, driving $$ミスリル$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) into a corner.

library.rt_160:r_cd7caf1d413d8979.text:
An AS operated by the secret organization Amalgam.
Under $$ミスリル$$'s classification code, it is designated a 'Venom' type machine.
It is said to have been developed based on the Eastern third-generation AS, the Zy-98, but its greatest feature is that this unit is fitted with a Lambda Driver, which allows it to display combat power surpassing the M9, the West's equivalent third-generation AS.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
In Hong Kong it appeared alongside $$ゲイツ$$' unit, driving $$ミスリル$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) into a corner. However, when $$宗介$$'s Arbalest arrived to their rescue, the tide of battle turned completely, and its units were destroyed one after another.

library.rt_160:r_8fdf15b6aa345119.text:
The final form born when Dancouga Nova and R-Daigan undergo Super Beast Fusion.
Dancouga Nova is a Super Robot born from the fusion of four Variable Beast Machines, and its original purpose of existence was to preserve all of Earth's life data against threats from space.
R-Daigan, on the other hand, existed to promote Dancouga Nova's evolution, but once that purpose was fulfilled, it came to fight alongside Dancouga Nova against threats from space.
When $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$'s ring shines with light, the seal on $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s Transcendence Mode is released, and after the call of the keyword 'M-A-X-G-O-D,' fusion begins. R-Daigan attaches to Dancouga Nova's back, doubling as a sub-generator and flight unit. As a result, in addition to eliminating the operational time limit that was Dancouga Nova's greatest weakness, it also gains the ability to fly.
It displayed enough power to blast away, in a single blow, a fused Unknown with performance exceeding Dancouga Nova's own, and defeated the $$オリジナル$$ Dancouga unleashed by Moon WILL.

library.rt_160:r_462b04f816ded0d3.text:
A giant fortress in the shape of a dragon.
Inside, it is equipped with well-appointed facilities including a maintenance factory, living quarters for its members, a hot spring, and a gym, making it more than just a mere combat base.
It was initially believed to be a base built in the inlet of Ryuga Island, but when it came under attack from forces sent by Moon WILL, it revealed its true form. Then, responding to $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$'s command, it emitted light and evolved Dancouga Nova into Max God.

library.rt_160:r_adbf6c3770573ef6.text:
The symbolic Gunmen of Team Dai-Gurren, which defeated the Spiral King and saved humanity.
It is completed when Gurren and Lagann combine, producing a power where one plus one equals more than two. It also boasts astonishing defensive performance thanks to features such as a regeneration ability that instantly restores Gurren and Lagann no matter how damaged they are, and a special energy field covering its surface.
Every attack is carried out with its drills. The freely extending and retracting drills can be used not only to pierce directly, but also to generate tornadoes using their rotational force, or to crack open the ground by driving them in.
After the new government was established, $$シモン$$ piloted it alone, but eventually his old rival $$ヴィラル$$ came to ride in Gurren's cockpit, pulling off a 'Fated Combination' that intertwined the two paths of man and beast.
It further combined with Arc-Gurren, which had been hidden beneath $$カミナ$$ City, giving birth to Arc-$$グレンラガン$$.

library.rt_160:r_5c762df2c0e618ac.text:
The symbolic Gunmen of Team Dai-Gurren, which defeated the Spiral King and saved humanity.
It is completed when Gurren and Lagann combine, producing a power where one plus one equals more than two. It also boasts astonishing defensive performance thanks to features such as a regeneration ability that instantly restores Gurren and Lagann no matter how damaged they are, and a special energy field covering its surface.
Every attack is carried out with its drills. The freely extending and retracting drills can be used not only to pierce directly, but also to generate tornadoes using their rotational force, or to crack open the ground by driving them in.
After the new government was established, $$シモン$$ piloted it alone, but eventually his old rival $$ヴィラル$$ came to ride in Gurren's cockpit, pulling off a 'Fated Combination' that intertwined the two paths of man and beast.
It further combined with Arc-Gurren, which had been hidden beneath $$カミナ$$ City, giving birth to Arc-$$グレンラガン$$, and that Arc-$$グレンラガン$$ then became the core of $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, giving birth to $$超銀河グレンラガン$$. $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ then broke through the heavens to become Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$, and Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$ in turn became Super Tengen Toppa $$グレンラガン$$.
In this way, centered on the Core Drill held by $$シモン$$ and on Lagann, $$グレンラガン$$ underwent what could be called limitless growth and evolution.

library.rt_160:r_46d4b71dee5dc8d4.text:
A Gunmen that appeared in Episode 9, 'Just What Is a Human, Anyway?'
Pursuing Lagann, whose Spiral Power was unstable, it descended into Princess Abandonment Valley and attacked $$シモン$$ and $$ニア$$, who had no machine to protect them.
Despite a build that can only be described as horse-faced, it is a heavily armed type, unimaginable from its appearance, equipped with claws, a gatling gun, and an abundant array of weapons ranging from small to large missiles.

library.rt_160:r_3217d0f381bab6fb.text:
A Gunmen that appeared in Episode 9, 'Just What Is a Human, Anyway?'
Pursuing Lagann, whose Spiral Power was unstable, it descended into Princess Abandonment Valley and attacked $$シモン$$ and $$ニア$$, who had no machine to protect them.
Despite a build that can only be described as horse-faced, it is a heavily armed type, unimaginable from its appearance, equipped with claws, a gatling gun, and an abundant array of weapons ranging from small to large missiles.
When $$ヨーコ$$ and $$キタン$$ rushed to the scene, it was destroyed by King $$キタン$$.

library.rt_160:r_32af2e2b0f50b965.text:
An ultra-dreadnought-class Space Gunmen boasting a size nearly equal to the Moon.
It was originally 'Cathedral Terra,' the flagship of the Spiral Tribe led by $$ロージェノム$$, but $$シモン$$ renamed it, and it became Team Dai-Gurren's base of operations in space.
It is so enormous that it cannot descend to Earth, and even moving within the ship is difficult without using warp gates.
It possesses a variety of functions beyond imagination, including not only the ability to travel across space-time, but also a hyperdimensional anchor capable of interfering with imaginary space, and a Spiral World Recognition Transfer System capable of instantly moving to any location it has ever perceived.

library.rt_160:r_dd0f079d1dda3e41.text:
A transcendent-spiral, super-dreadnought Gunmen transformed from $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.
Its core block is the fully drillized Arc-$$グレンラガン$$.
$$シモン$$'s Spiral Power activates $$グレンラガン$$, $$グレンラガン$$'s drill gives birth to Arc-$$グレンラガン$$, and the energy from Arc-$$グレンラガン$$'s Super Spiral Engine drives $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ -- making it, in a sense, the strongest Gunmen in the universe, a true symbol of Spiral Power.
The giant drills on both shoulders are launched and merge into a single super-giant Giga Drill, unleashing the finishing move, the Super Galaxy Giga Drill Break.

library.rt_160:r_1bf514e5dd9054ef.text:
The ultimate Gunmen, one that breaks through both the heavens and dimensions itself.
It was born in the Spiral Universe, where perception becomes reality, when all the surviving members of Team Dai-Gurren became core drills and spun on together.
It boasts a scale so vast that it can hurl entire galaxies and use them as footholds.
Each of the face-like parts visible across its body carries a pilot. Each person materialized weapons of their specialty one after another -- rifles, swords, anchors -- and waged the final battle against the Anti-Spiral Grand Zamboa.

library.rt_160:r_c5b5b05539363890.text:
The ultimate Gunmen, one that breaks through both the heavens and dimensions itself.
It was born in the Spiral Universe, where perception becomes reality, when all the surviving members of Team Dai-Gurren became core drills and spun on together.
It boasts a scale so vast that it can hurl entire galaxies and use them as footholds.
Each of the face-like parts visible across its body carries a pilot. Each person materialized weapons of their specialty one after another -- rifles, swords, anchors -- and waged the final battle against the Anti-Spiral Grand Zamboa.
During the battle, though driven into a corner, it achieved Super Tengen Toppa and defeated Grand Zamboa.
